scope: All23 captured public SVG strings, not a sample; 140 route instances across state captures are counted separately.
limitations: Output/input kind comes from public SVG port attribute names and classes; this is independent numerical verification of public SVG internal geometry, not independent semantic graph/source correctness.

Leaf card interiors are strict open axis-aligned source rectangles. Container regions intentionally excluded. Rounded corners, stroke widths, marker envelopes, glyphs, labels, focus outline and hit targets are not separately inflated or checked.
Marker definitions and orientation properties resolved for every route; exact arrow pixels/contacts, clipping and device-scale rendering are not certified by source parsing.
Each original screenshot was actually viewed in separate detailed reports, but screen-fit visual contact checks were coarse, not an exhaustive per-pixel raster proof.
Node overlaps and route crossings in move-down-final are preserved warnings/conflict evidence; corresponding applied capture is geometrically clear under this finite check.
